title: Another wonderful product from Fisher-Price!!
text: I had this set up and ready to go, when my soon to be two year grandson came to visit. OMG, he squealed with delight the second he saw it. His father has an ATV that he regularly takes my grand baby out on. Of course, this set 'he' was able to be the driver. Such a hit, never knew this was going to be as big a deal as it ended up being. We couldn't even get him off of this for dinner. I knew with the Fisher-Price name,  this would a safe and ride for him! Thank goodness he fell asleep prior to the time he had to leave, so his parents were able to pry him from this, lol. My daughter in law called me yesterday to tell me that all her son keeps saying is 'Memaw bike?' Needless to say, they will back next weekend. I am so happy I got this set. This will make a wonderful Christmas/holiday gift for the toddler in your life.

title: Another quality fun product from Fisher-Price!
text: My grandson absolutely flipped out over this set. He loves the colors and the music and the elephant (he even takes it into bed with him, lol). I love Fisher-Price, and I buy their products almost exclusively for my grandkids. Educational, safe, and so much fun. I love the fact that the legs on the elephant move so my three year old grandbaby can move it across the floor like it was alive! No complaints at all about this product and I, too, have purchased other items in the Little People series and this one set is just as good, if not better, than others I have bought. This would make a wonderful Christmas or Holiday present for the little one in your life.

title: Lots of laughs, great fun for the whole family!
text: Played this game last night with my son and his wife (both age 32) along with my grandson (age 11) and what fun we had! I had never played the original version, but my son had and he thought this version was much more fun. You are able to fill in your own answers, which easily could get a little off color, if it was just left up to the adults. Again, they seem to list an age range of 12-15 on the product page, but I would say ages 10 and up, due to the fact that the adults in this household has as much, if not more, fun as my grandson!

title: Great game for all ages!
text: I can't talk to any ages other than this, but I will say that I played this game along with my son (age 31), daughter in law (age 29) and 4 year old (soon to be 5) grand daughter. We had an absolute blast with loads of laughs while playing this (from the youngest to the oldest). Yes, there are a lot of pieces (so you need to keep tabs on them so they don't get lost) and I agree with one of the other reviewers who stated that the shark itself will probably not last for years by any means (takes a lot of abuse). But overall, I have to recommend this game to all. I also like that as my grand daughter gets a year or so older, we can modify the play to help accommodate her skills/capability. This would make a wonderful gift under the tree this year for the youngster in your life. And the box, with the exposed shark, is really cool and will gain the attention of any youngster for sure.

title: Fun for the whole family!
text: Great fun for children of all ages! I bought this for my grandchildren, but I found myself yelling at my 30 year old boys to put it down and let the little ones play with it, lol. Lots of water, great stream of water, this flash flood blaster really fits the bill as a great blaster/soaker for sure! I love Nerf products. I live in Florida now and with the hot weather down here, these (I just purchased another Nerf super soaker as well) will be used at every pool party I guarantee!

title: Playing with horses has never been so much fun!!!!
text: I gave this to my granddaughter to play with when she visited last weekend. I knew that she loved the My Little Pony dolls, but she didn't have one of the Glamour Glow series, so I knew she was in for a big treat. First, this is a nice size for her 5 year old hands and she had so much fun combing and styling it's hair/mane/tale. Hours of fun, and she squealed with delight when I turned on the horsie and the lights started. Great present for the girl in your life. She also loves horses in general, so this has now been her favorite new toy. Despite what the little video states on this page ('batteries not included'), they are. So, it's fun right out of the box. Kudos to Hasbro!

title: Imagination in action!
text: Rating this a four stars as it is costly and probably an appliance box would work better. However, I like the fact that it has windows and such already cut out and that you can color it. My grandson (4) loved it when I set it up with my son and spent hours (before coloring) playing the 'king'. Again, it is attractive looking, but is lightweight and will not probably hold up with multiple kids inside. But for one child playing alone (or with their parents), it's great. Good imaginative playing for hours and the coloring and personalizing make it worth the cost.

title: Another classic Fisher Price learning toy!
text: My grandson absolutely loved this. He spent hours the first time he played with it, and he actually fought us when we asked him to stop for dinner. I love these Little People Fisher Price toys, and my grandson has another one (airplanes). They are not only educational (good for the parents to discuss the farm animals, the doors, the grass, upstairs/downstairs, etc.), but so much fun for little hands to maneuver the 'people' and animals around the barn/farm. Safe, colorful, hours of fun. This would make a great Christmas present for the toddler in your life.

title: Great, hours of fun, learning experience for toddlers!
text: To begin with, I absolutely love Fisher-Price toys. When my own sons were toddlers I had a closet filled with toys that were not only fun but educational. Now that I have grandchildren, I also try to keep the value of toys in mind when giving them to children. This Laugh and Learn Piggy Bank does not disappoint. My 14 month old grandson spent hours on the first day playing with this. He loves the music, the interaction and the colorful pieces. He is still at the stage of putting things in his mouth but these 'coins' are totally safe and cannot be swallowed. I love that he is just starting to speak and I can see trying to say the word 'uno' on the second stage of this. This bank is a smart toy and teaches children coordination, colors and sounds. Makes a great, relatively inexpensive toy, for the baby or grandbaby in your house. Would make a great holiday present.

title: Another great Radio Flyer product!
text: I got this last week, put it together in minutes (and, trust me, I hate to have to assemble things). My 4 year old granddaughter has not stopped using it. It is better, in my opinion, than a bicycle for first time kids on wheels. Low to the ground, great wheel stability and easy for kids to maneuver. If there was any downside at all (and I don't think it's a big deal) is that it can be a bit noisy. Let's put it this way, with my Sophie going down the sidewalk, no one will not notice or hear her coming. I guess that's a good thing. Bicycles have rubber tires, this has plastic wheels and on cement or even hardwood floors, it can be a little annoying. But you must trust me, the noise is a small trade off for the hours of fun your kids (and grandkids) can have, Would make a great under the tree present this year at a reasonable price for the first time wheeler adventure!

title: Great for the developing musical protegy in your home!
text: I love this Melissa & Doug Upright Piano. Beautiful colors, quality made, bigger than I expected and an amazing sound from what is considered a children's toy. My grandson who is three absolutely adores this (he even likes when I make a melody out of playing Chopsticks, lol). I can see where in another year he will be able to play little tunes on it. For now, he loves experimenting with the sounds, going from low to high and back again. I come from a musical family and I have always prided myself on introducing my own children (and now my grandchildren) to the wonderful world of music. This Melissa & Doug Upright Piano is the perfect way to start a toddler learning to love music at an early age. This would make a wonderful Christmas gift under the tree this year for the future virtuoso in your family!

title: Another great Leap Frog product!
text: I need to start out by saying, I love the Leap Frog product line. With a very active almost 2 year old grandson, I buy many of these to help him learn, but also have fun. This little dog is well made and is fun for him to pull around. The learning of the alphabet is just icing on the cake. I can't say enough about Leap Frog. This toy is less than $20 and should be on everyone's wish list for the holidays for the little ones (I don't know if I would go as high as three year olds, but definitely the 1-2 year old set would love to see this under the tree this year. Educational and fun for hours of entertainment. Can't go wrong.

title: Such cuties!
text: I absolutely love these little dolls. To be honest, I gave them to my niece to play with and she wouldn't put them down. After watching her navigate to the website (absolutely incredible for a 4 year old to be this computer literate), I was sold on this doll. I really would love to own these myself, lol. You can't go wrong with this as a stocking stuffer, add on gift, or a quick little reward for good grades or work. I love them and they will provide hours of fun for your child.

title: Great puzzle!
text: Let me start by saying I love jigsaw puzzles and I love Italy, so this puzzle fits the bill for something to do in my free time. I have never been to Portofino, but after having worked on this for upwards of a month, the harbor is definitely now on my bucket list. The colors are vibrant, the pieces are sturdy and the finished picture is breathtaking and definitely framable (if you are into doing that with your puzzles). It is challenging, yet fairly easy to do. Would think this is more for an adult with a passion for travel and the old country (more so than for a young child). I would highly reccommend this to anyone who loves jigsaw puzzles. Ravensburger makes the best (in my opinion).

title: Absolutely great, challenging, educational puzzle
text: Both my uncle and my father were in the construction industry in NYC/Brooklyn in the 1930's-40's. When I saw this, I remembered the stories I used to hear about how they would dangle from beams on the skyscraper construction. This puzzle is unique that it is in black and white (which is a new, unique challenge for me) and at the same time educational/inspirational for people of all ages. To see how our ancestors had to build the skyscrapers that we all take for granted today, before all the safety precautions of today, is eye-opening. I love puzzles and try to complete one every month or two. I am hooked on black and white now as it brings a whole new dimension to trying to match and fit pieces. I highly recommend this for everyone.

title: frog bubble machine
text:
Where to start.... the only "good" thing... it makes lots of bubbles. Awesome right?? Until you realize that you must literally STAND right next to it to keep it "fed" with bubble soap. OMG. It will run for about 1 minute before you must refill it. I am SOOO disappointed. It might be more expensive to buy a "pro" bubble machine... but unless you want to post someone to stand there and keep refilling it... *EH* It went right into the dumpster. Partly because in an attempt to "enlarge" the soap capacity, my husband destroyed it. All in frustration. In any case... if you want more than 1 minute of bubbles, go for the more expensive, larger capacity machines. If you are into the bubbles 1 minute at a time... this the machine for you. I never look forward to posting negative reviews.. but sometimes to be honest, it must be done.
UPDATE: 12/5/2018 ... I wish I could rate this ZERO stars... The seller keeps offering me a full refund AND a toy "worth $39.99" to change my review from 1 star to 5. STAY AWAY FROM THIS TOY!

text:
To be honest, I purchased two of these types of cats... This one sounds horribly mechanical, jerky - almost looks like the cat is having a seizure. One eye is bright and shiny, the other is dull and scratched.... In order to get the cat out of the box I had to literally destroy the box, otherwise, it would totally be going back - in a second. I'm disappointed to say the least. Even the fur was nicer on the Joy brand! The FurReal brand also did not "go to sleep" either... it was constantly moving - (I see a LOT of batteries being used). The meow sound is very odd and fake. title: Very sturdy and worth it
text:
purchased for my grandsons to use when visiting..... it is large.... large enough for an an adult to get into. The material is a cotton canvas... not terribly thick, but not too thin in my opinion. It was relatively easy to put together... I like that this is a bottom floor attached. It is quite popular to stay grandma's and camp out.... The poles are wood... a pine I believe... very sturdy. I would recommend this teepee... I always update if there are any issues that may be helpful.
3/25/2016 UPDATE: ...so I just finished deconstructing the teepee and felt an undate with tips might be helpful... first... you will never get the canvas teepee back into the canvas bag provided... it's like folding/rolling a really thick fitted sheet and trying to get into a tube sock.... BUT the wooden poles fit nicely into the canvas bag along with the plastic connector pieces... it would have been nice if the connectors gripped the poles better and stayed connected during the deconstruct phase... however... I just removed all the holed top pieces and then turned the teepee upside down and shook it sort of like a pillow case... the lower pieces eventually come out... I just rolled the teepee up, put all the poles and connector pieces in the bag and set in a large drawer I have. I would have lowered my rating one star for the deconstruct hassle, but honestly, my grandsons love it so much I just can't. The quality is such that this is going to last for many years if we take care of it. It's just a matter of learning how to use it in an efficient manner. Also... I have hard wood floors, so I went to a local carpet store and purchased some carpet padding. I cut into a circle and place it under the teepee when I have it set up... I worry less about bonked heads that way - grandsons 5 years and 2 years. Ok! Hope this is indeed helpful info!

Listen it lights up and eventually it will die as the batteries are not replaceable... but WHO CARES? You can STILL skip it! I am LOVING this. Wish I was still as young and bouncy as I used to be 40 years ago... but I adored it then and now. I just can't do it for hours like I used to...and I'm a bit slower. :) I'm pretty sure this counts as exercise and it's fun! Of course, mine is covered in sand cause I skip on the wide open beach. If you were a fan of the original, you'll find this amusing and it works! I'm getting two more... one for my sister (else she WILL steal mine) and one for the house that isn't covered with sand. :) You do need a pretty good size area that is clear... but it works on floors or carpets and sand of course. I'm pretty sure people think it's very amusing to see an old, fat lady skipping down the beach. HA!
The loop is plenty big enough to slip over your shoe... 5 1/2" diameter on the side of the plastic ankle loop... the cord is tube covered (this is REALLY important because otherwise the cord just wraps around your ankle and you can't "skip it").... the ball is attached to cord very well... I yanked on it... stood and pulled... obviously more than you need to do... but I wanted to test it.
You don't get to pick your color... doesn't bother me. I got a really great purple one in my first order.
I will update if there are any breakage issues, but honestly it's pretty dang well made and I don't expect those kinds of issues.

title: better than adding to the landfill
text:
They are plastic, and striped only in the front and oposite side... but that is okay for me...
Took a star off for the HORRIBLE tape they had ALL OVER them. AND terrible paper stickers on the bottom of each one. Took me 3 hours with a LOT of orange de-sticker stuff to remove. WHAT a nightmare... WHY on earth would you tape all sides with the worst tape ever??
They are very, very lightweight... and flexible. I would NOT put them in the dishwasher.
Took another star off because they are SO cheap and NOT 100% recycled, I knew that before purchasing... but I can still wish.
Others have reported Dollar store pricing.. I don't have a dollar store, and paid about $2 each for the set of 4 including shipping. They certainly are not worth more than that.
So, that leaves us with 3 stars. The up side is that you are not adding more garbage to a landfill by washing and reusing these. They are a good method for portion control (otherwise, I'd sit with the giant stainless mixing bowl full on my lap).
I can't say I would recommend them, unless you were considering paper disposables.

title: Requires gentle, yet strength to assemble
text:
I was super excited to receive this item because it claims to light up and turn in multiple ways, however assembly was a pain! Assembly of this product was so painstaking, I ended up having a couple of dented finger nails, some splinters, and a bunch of broken and scratched up skin. This item requires a lot of finger strength, yet it requires gentle assembly. There are certain parts during assembly where it requires me to gently slide in one part, yet push it in with force. the longitudinal wood pieces came in 12 pieces, but to assemble, it must fit into 5 different slots. I broke about 9 little slots in 9 difference pieces. The instructions were all pictures, but certain parts of the instruction must be studied in detail!!! I studied certain steps and was confident; turned out, I was wrong and had to break it apart which caused more broken wooden pieces. The last part, one of the pieces didn't come fully cut, so when I pushed a piece in, it snapped. Overall, if this item I assembled was not examined in detail, nobody would see any of the cracks. I like what I assembled and it did turn out great, but I refuse to ever do this again!

and it wont turn! I waxed the pieces that required waxing, but as hard as I try to turn the knobs, the globe wont turn! If I force, it'll turn a little bit, but I feel like it might break!

title: Fox and Racoon too big or Moose is too Small
text: These seem like good quality and the colors are nice and seem accurate.  I was concerned that the horns of the moose might be sharp and could hurt a child if they fell on the toy, but no worries here; the horns are soft and bendable.  If you tried to bend them much, they might break off though.  The price seems reasonable.  If you buy them to teach your children about these animals, there is one problem.  The racoon and fox are over half the size of the moose, so the proportions are all wrong.  The fox and racoon are about the right size in relation to each other, but next to the moose, the grouping looks strange.  Looks like we an have incredibly large mutant fox and racoon or incredibly small mutant moose.  I noticed there are other groupings available in this brand and I would have paired the moose with maybe a bear and a deer.  Then put the fox and racoon with another animal about their size.  The package contains only one small paragraph about the 3 animals, so this is not an educational toy by any stretch of the imagination.  Smaller, younger kids probably won't care about any educational benefit anyway or the size proportions of the animals, so this may not be a big deal.  As a kid, I would have loved a set like this.  I suppose a smart kid would pick up on the size discrepancy if they have ever been to a zoo and seen some of these animals or seen a TV program that showed the sizes.

title: Well Constructed, Realistic Looking, Good for Play or Collectors, Kids or Adults
text: I guess I am a kid at heart, as I loved the movie CARS.  I got these with intentions of giving them to some children, but I like them so well, I am going to keep them.  They appear to be quite well constructed, made of a combination of hard plastic, metal and on "Mater" some rubberized material for his mirrors and towing chains.  The vehicles are small, being about 3" long and 1 to 2 inches high.  They are nicely detailed and well painted and are not cheap looking.  They would be fun to play with for kids, especially if they have seen and liked the Cars movie.  These seem rugged enough to handle quite a bit of play. title: Okay Toy; Not Great
text: My great grandson who is about 6 did not care for this toy.  In order to launch Thomas the train engine, you have to physically tip up the track.  The function of the toy is rather limited, as it seems to do just one thing.  The engine runs along a track and a shark tries to grab it; then it does a loop.  That's about it.  The included helicopter is supposed to carry Thomas off to safety after he escapes the shark, but obviously that's something that occurs only in a child's imagination.  The helicopter is just an extra included toy and can stand alone.  It's not a bad toy and the engine is cute and well made.  Probably not something that your child would find that many hours of entertainment from.  There are better toys out there for about the same money.

title: Colorful and awesome dragon; fun set with some challenge
text: The dragon in this set is really awesome looking.  It's quite a clever toy and involves some skill in aiming the car correctly to hit the dragon.  I think kids stay with a toy longer if there is some challenge to it and not just a passive toy.  Very colorful and fun.  With all the moving parts and a lot of plastic, I am not sure how long it would last without breaking.  Unfortunately just about everything is made from plastic these days, so there is not much choice for truly durable toys.  Although probably best suited for a boy, I can't imagine any kid, boy or girl, not liking this.

title: FUN FOR KIDS WHO LIKE DINOSAURS
text: What kid doesn't like dinosaurs?  This is perfert for your boy or girl who is into dinosaurs.  I suppose it could be considered an educational toy, but probably only marginally so.  Who says educational toys can't be fun too?  This is especially nice for a kid interested in archeology.  Contains a block of plaster that has embedded into it "DNA" stickers and a glow in the dark dinosaur.  After the fun of digging out the dinosaur and stickers with the included digging tools and brush, they are left with a dinosaur model, so even though the digging fun is over after one time (if they do it all at once), there is something to show for it.  There are also two "augmented reality" (AR) play mats that are completed with the DNA stickers that have been "excavated".  The mats when used with a cell phone and an application from the App Store (for Apple phones) or the Google Play Store (for Androids) produces a 3D dinosaur, visible on the phone.  One problem with this is that it might not work with all cell phones.  It is supposed to work with MOST Apple devices (8.0 and above).  On Android phones the only devices tested are Google Nexus Series, Samsung Galaxy S5 and Samsung Galaxy Tab.  I didn't have a cell phone to test this on, but it seems like it still might be fun even if that part doesn't work.  It's just that you might not be able to use the full capability of the kit if your phone doesn't work with the application.  Also if you give this to a child of only 8 (the lower age limit on this), they may not yet have a cell and you may not want them to have one at that age.  Since this contains many small parts, it needs to be kept away from small children, as there is a choking hazard (box says no one under 3).  I would have loved a toy like this when I was a kid.  Just remember to put down a newspaper when they are working on the plaster block in order to collect all the plaster pieces that are chipped off as they excavate.  Pricing of the kit is very reasonable.  Made in China.

title: VERY NICE DETAIL; WELL-CONSTRUCTED; MOLDED IN SEVERAL COLORS; GREAT FOR KIDS WHO LIKE HORSES
text: This is a really cute set good sized set (roughly 18 inches long and 4 inches high) made of rugged plastic and with real rubber tires.  The truck looks realistic with nice details inside the cab with a center console, two bucket seats, a dashboard and a steering wheel.  It is molded in 4 colors plus a clear plastic windshield, sunroof and back window.  The side doors have no windows.  The steering wheel turns, but is not functional for turning the wheels.  The two front doors of the truck both open.  The hood of the truck opens to reveal an engine.  Nice detail including non-functioning headlights, parking lights, front grill, side mirrors, gas cap and a rear tailgate that also opens.  The only assembly required on the truck is putting on the 4 tires, which should be easy for just about any kid.  The horse trailer also requires putting on 4 tires and a special wheel in the front; also there are 6 trailer pieces that have to be snapped in place. An illustrated book shows how to install the pieces.  Pretty easy, but a younger child might have a little trouble figuring it out.  The pictures on the side of the trailer and the license plates on the truck and trailer are provided in a sheet of stickers, which a child can place where they like.  Includes a completely black horse with a blanket, 2 figures (a driver for the truck and a handler for the horse) and several accessories for the horse including a bridle, halter, saddle, a couple brushes, a bale of hay and a bunch of carrots.  Suitable for both boys or girls, especially those who like horses.  Probably this toy would be preferred by girls since the truck is pink and the horse handler is female. Even some adult collectors might like this set as it is colorful, detailed and well made. The real downside that I see to this set is that if you have very young children who will be around this, they could easily put one of the small pieces in their mouth and choke.  There is no instructions on showing how to use the horse accessories; most are obvious, but a couple are not.  The most important thing to know is that this is more of an "old school" type of toy; no batteries, no motors, no remotes.  A lot of kids today want the latest electronic devices and radio controlled toys, but this toy allows them to use their imaginations a little. I think that's a plus, but if you buy this for the kid who wants a cell phone instead, there will be a level of disappointment, I'm sure.  Note that this is made by a German company, with components from Germany, China, Romania and Tunisia. It's not that important to me where it is made, but it might be to you.  Note too that you can also buy other items in this series, such as a barn type structure, a corral and other horses.  If your child insists on other components, it could get expensive, if you give in.  As a kid at heart, I like this toy a lot myself and would keep it if I didn't have so many other things.  It will probably go to a grandson.

title: GREAT TOY IF YOUR CHILD IS YOUNG ENOUGH AND LIGHT ENOUGH
text: My great-grandson liked this a lot and really enjoyed riding it.  He's not a large kid, but is one year older than the recommended ages for the toy.  He is within the weight limit, which I think is 50 pounds or under.  He can probably enjoy it for about a year, but he was almost too big for it now so you probably don't want to get this for a child who is approaching the upper age limit, which I think the box said was 5.  Also, if you have a big child close to the maximum age and maximum weight, they might not fit the toy.  At around a $200 price, I consider this to be a luxury toy and you might be able to find toys for a lot less that would be just as much fun for a kid.  I recommend getting it for kids at the lower end of the age range (2 or 3), so they can enjoy it for a few years before they outgrow it.  Of course you can always donate it when they do outgrow it.  Not much to assemble on it and the few parts that need to be put on are easy to install.  The only real downside to this toy is the initial charge time of 18 hours.  Kids are impatient (some adults are too) and if you present this to them and then they find out they can't use it until the next day, there could be some disappointment.  Of course that could be a way to teach patience too.  After the initial overnight charge, the battery seemed to last quite well, so they should be able to enjoy a driving session until they lose interest and a recharge is needed.  This is not huge, but it is a large item that you need a storage place for and a place to plug it in while it is charging.  As several reviewers have said, this works better on hard surfaces.  This doesn't move very fast, but fast enough for younger kids; older kids might find it too slow.  Obviously too, as a kid gets older they might not find a toy like this that "cool".  Since this is a motorized riding toy, obviously you do need to supervise a kid while riding it, especially younger ones; don't buy it if you think you are going to turn your kid loose with it and not have to watch them.  You need adequate space in your house or a big driveway to use this, as you probably don't want the kids driving it in the street, unless you live in a very low traffic residential area and/or are right beside them when they are using it.  Probably best for use on sidewalks or a fenced yard if you are going to use it outside.  Keep in mind too that if you go any great distance away from your house and the charge runs out, you now have a 50 pound toy to somehow get home.  How noisy a toy is also can be a factor on whether you want to get it or not; this runs reasonably quiet, which is a plus.  A fun toy for the appropriately aged small child.

title: Not Really a Toy; This is an Advanced Modeler's Kit
text:
This kit is made of cast metal parts of just a single silvery color, so it has to be painted to look good. It's very small, only about 3" by 2". I had a lot of trouble getting the walls to stay glued and fitting them together properly. The parts have to be washed with soap and water before they will stick, but even that didn't help much I switched super glues and had a little better luck. You need cyanoacrylate glue to glue the metal pieces together.

The picture of the model on the box cover is decorated by a professional modeler or artists, so depending on how skillful you are, your results might not be as good.

I think this is marketed as a toy, but it's not a toy. It's designed for people who want to spend some time building and custom painting a model railroad structure.

Both the advantage and disadvantage of this kit is that you can custom paint it any way you like. That's more work than kits that are cast or molded in multiple colors, but looks more like you built it, than coming from a kit that anyone can buy and build.

For the high price that Woodland Scenics charges for their kits, it would be nice if they would include basic paint colors in the kit or at least include the information on what paints to buy and techniques for painting and weathering. I was able to e-mail the company and they quickly and generously supplied the info, but one shouldn't have to ask. It should be a part of the kit.

It's hard to beat the realistic look of these kits, but it does require some time and skill to build and decorate to get the look you want.

This kit is not really worth the money, since it is so small and requires so much work to get it looking good.

title: Very Cute Doll
text:
This is a very cute doll that any little girl (and perhaps some boys) would adore.
Even adults who are into collecting dolls might be interested, although I would not call this a collector doll by any means. It is a doll that is meant to be played with. The pretend scissors look pretty safe and do move back and forth and make a clicking sound. The water squirt bottle might be okay for some kids, but I know some kids would be using it to squirt someone with, instead of the doll's hair, so use your own judgment on that. At least it only holds a few ounces of water or whatever you put in it. Some kids I know would probably put soda in it and be squirting it into their mouths! The doll does have a really full head of hair, so those children who enjoy it, will probably have fun combing the hair and styling it and using one of 3 barrettes. Educational value for grooming?--maybe a little, but this is not an educational toy. The dress the doll wears is cute, with a pink poodle on it. I really don't think you can go wrong with this doll as a gift for young children who like dolls, even if they don't care that much about the grooming aspect. The eyes are painted on and don't look realistic to me, but at least nothing that can be broken or poked out. The doll's skin is slightly brown and the box has Spanish wording as well as English, so could be appropriate for children of varying skin tones.

title: My boyfriend flushed it!
text:
The package"arrived this evening, I'd snuck into the bathroom and positioned it perfectly in drape of the seat. Unfortunately, boyfriend did not use the bathroom immediately despite my estimations, in fact HOURS went by and suddenly I heard a flushing.

I asked if he flushed it. He looked at me. I now know this man loves me above all things as there was no judgement in his expression, just a solemn nod. Despite my laughter, he was still slightly shell shocked and not sure how to respond. He wasn't sure to believe that it was plastic. "It looked so real," he lamented with regret because now he wishes he could have kept the poo.

So far, no plumbing issues resulted in the flushing. Not sure how we'd explain that to maintenance. Summary: Don't hesitate, gag your family and friends but make sure they don't flush it!!! Best $5 I've spent in a while.

title: Scratches the League of Legends itch in Board Game format
text:
I was looking for a DotA / MOBA in board game format and this fits the bill pretty nicely.

It's quite expensive and also a massively complex game. Not for the faint of heart. If you want super premium components, you get what you pay for. Comes with cases and shelves for all the components, and the art on the neoprene mats and the cards is gorgeous. I'm quite happy with it, but it's one of those "big box" games that you only need one or maybe two of in your entire collection.

As a game it feels a bit different than League of Legends (as it should given the format), but it's just something to be aware of and expect. I had been designing my own DotA board game and it's not exactly what I had in mind, but it's definitely fun.

The biggest drawback is the learning time and the playing time. I wouldn't even consider doing more than 2 players unless everyone in the group had already played several 2 player games and knew the rules well. It could really benefit from simultaneous turns and I'll be thinking up some house rules for sure to make the playthroughs not take quite so long.

The races are pretty asymmetric which some people might not like. You need to learn one race and stick with it. The complexity is far too big to bounce around and try each race in turn. Each race's choice of minions, spires, heroes, and faction upgrades has a LOT of different options and it could be pretty overwhelming at first. Learning all the different abilities, how they work, and figuring out how to work that into your strategy and gameplay.

title: Basically Jurassic Park the game
text:
I already like Tiny Epic games. This is probably my favorite. If you can imagine a Jurassic Park game, this is more or less the one you want. Small package, great price, endless fun. What more can you ask for?

You build parks and enclosures to house dinosaurs. The dinosaurs are hungry. If you can't feed them, they'll still eat - guess what? - your other dinosaurs! Very well made and lots of fun. If you don't like this game, maybe board games aren't your thing.

I look at this game as an example to understand how to make games well. I think anyone who likes board games has to give at least one Tiny Epic game a try, and this is the one I would recommend most.

Limited closet space? Desperate for something besides Monopoly, Risk, or Settlers of Catan? Like building games with dire consequences? Think dinosaurs are the least bit cool or interesting? Look no further.

My only minor criticism is that some might consider it complex with the different special dinosaurs and some of the rules about how and when to place dinos. Any board game is going to have a learning curve, and this one is small.

title: Great quality Goban (Go board)
text:
If you're looking for a wonderful thinking game, this is an excellent purchase to get started. It comes with a Go instruction booklet as well, which hits all the high points of gameplay without being too long or boring. If you read your way through the entire book (about 20 illustrated pages) you will be well on your way to understanding most aspects of the game.

Several tips to note about this board:

It has 9x9 grid on one side and 13x13 on the other, which makes it the perfect board for beginners or those learning Go. These smaller sizes are normally used by less experienced players to learn the basics of the game, without being overwhelmed by the length of a full 19x19 match. A 9x9 game, depending on how long the players take to think about their moves, will take about 10 to 20 minutes, and a 13x13 game takes about 20 to 40 minutes.

The wood is spruce and is very good quality for a beginner's board. I have not used it for very long so I don't know how long it would take the lines on the board to wear off or show signs of use. However, it's still in pristine quality from when I bought it, and I've used it quite thoroughly. Any dust or dirt can be easily wiped off with a dry or slightly damp cloth (it comes with instructions on how to care for the board).

Of primary consideration is the quality of the Go stones that come with this board. If you don't have any stones, this is also a great purchase because the stones are rust-proof and will never crack, break, or corrode. They are nice and big, so they are easy to hold and become used to playing Go with. Another plus is that it comes with enough stones for a 19x19 game, so if you later choose to purchase a full sized board, you'll have enough stones to play with.

Overall, a great purchase if you want to jump into learning how to play Go.

title: Lego for adults is genius marketing and a lot of fun!!
text:
As a child I was a huge fan of Legos and had dozens of sets… Ranging from castles to pirates.
However, they’ve been sitting in boxes in the basement for the last 30 years… When I happen to discover Lego‘s new botanical collection at the botanical garden, I had to buy for nostalgia value.

The first thing I immediately noticed is the boxes are much harder to open… I actually had to look on YouTube for how to open it without destroying the box. (hint: run a butter knife along the edge to loosen the glue). Once I got it out of the box, it is self-explanatory, with components labeled in four separate bags and an assembly tool.

It took me around two hours to assemble, a lot of the assembly is repetitive as you are making the same parts over and over for the base, stems, and flowers.

The base is highly interesting as it looks very simple from the outside, but it’s made of rotating parts inside in different colors.

The flower stems can be arranged at different heights and patterns, making it fun to customize. I loved the realistic snaking roots and Dirt toned blocks to fill in around the stems.

I paid $50 for this from the official Lego store and don’t regret it for a second; it looks fantastic on top of my Japanese tea chest and it was a lot of fun. My next challenge is a Lego bonsai!

title: A fantastic family project and must-have for Stars Wars fans!
text:
No stranger to Legos, I've been assembling various themed kits since the early 1980s. I was also a child when the original Stars Wars movies came out, and over the years have owned various Stars Wars merchandise like lunchboxes, toys, action figures, Viewmaster Slides, and other collectibles.

So when I was offered the chance to test drive the LEGO Millennium Falcon, I was overjoyed.

It had been years since I last assembled a Lego set.

The level of detail on this is amazing - it has an opening cockpit, interior access, hidden compartments, spring-loaded external weapons and five figures including C3PO and R2D2.

With nearly 1,400 pieces, this is not a kit for the short of patience or faint of heart, but it DOES make a fantastic project the whole family can enjoy together.

(and if you lose / misplace the directions, you can handily download / print from Lego's official website if you search by kit number 7527).

The perfect gift for any Star Wars fan, whether you're a child or a child at heart!

title: Beautifully-crafted puzzle will provide hours of entertainment
text:
I had the luck of visiting Portofino last October, and was instantly hooked on this 1,000-piece Ravensburger puzzle that perfectly captures the vibrant colors and Mediterranean atmosphere of the town. The framing of the photo is interesting as well, with several moored boats in the foreground and the harbor in the background. The level of detail in the high-resolution photo is amazing (the finished puzzle measures 27 X 20). The puzzle pieces are sturdy (unlike some cheaper puzzles I've assembled) and nonglare.

This is a fabulous challenge to have on hand for weekends or relaxation; the large amount of blue in the water and sky make these more difficult sections to accomplish, but the end result is well worth the effort!

title: A true VIP (Very Irish Princess)
text: Coming from an Irish family, I have accumulated many different types of Irish collectibles over the years: stuffed animals, Beanie Babies, glasses, books, jewelery...all with some sort of Irish theme. But until recently I didn't have any Irish dolls, porcelain or otherwise. I have been collecting Dolls of the World Barbies for a number of years, and more recently Princess of the World dolls, so I couldn't believe it when I found out that a Princess of Ireland Barbie would be made. I was nervous that the doll wouldn't "feel" Irish enough. So when I received her in the mail I was pleasantly surprised that she was even more beautiful than in the photos online. Her complexion is very fair, and her auburn hair is stunning in natural light. Her green eyes are sparkling and mysterious, and she wears a very light rose eyeshadow that makes her beautiful eyes stand out even more. Her costume is sort of a medieval/Celtic blend. She wears a velvety soft forest green cloak with a golden Tara brooch clasp, a traditional Celtic design. Her dress is a crinkly olive green fabric with a stripe of Celtic designs down the middle. At her waist she wears a belt of three golden medallions with Celtic designs, and on her head, perfectly balanced atop her auburn hair, a golden crown fit for an Irish princess. The box she comes in is also perfect for displaying her in. Appropriately enough, it is green (Ireland is actually a Viking word for green) with golden trim. The backdrop inside of the box is an Irish castle. There is information about the Celts on the back of the box. This is sure to become a treasured keepsake in my family, and I'm planning on buying more for relatives and friends.

title: Beautiful, but quality is lacking *Edited 2/1/20*
text:
The puzzle is beautiful, and the colors are vibrant. It adds a level of difficulty as the blacks on the mountain are almost completely indistinguishable.

My wife and I have had fun building this puzzle together, but the state in which a good portion of the pieces cake to us is disheartening.

A lot of the pieces have the backing peeling off, and it look like whatever machine cut these pieces out needs to be sharpened. It has left a good amount of the pieces with portions of the other pieces attached to them still.

I’m hoping that this is a fluke for my wife and my set, but that can’t be verified by us alone.

*Edit - February 1st*

The puzzle creator sent my wife and I a replacement puzzle and an additional different puzzle as compensation. While the original puzzle was lacking in quality manufacturing, the customer service of the seller has gone above and beyond.

Thank you so much for trying to make this right.

title: Great for All ages!
text: My 13 year old received this as a reward gift! She loves it! We took close-ups of the inside of each geode. My husband helped with the larger geode. We all enjoy it!

title: Daughter loves!
text: Gift for my daughter. For all her hard work online in school and doing her chores! She loves it! Has a book describing each stone etc.

title: Cute!
text: Not only is this a cute piggy bank, it's also pretty durable. It's light weight (without coins, of course). It's a fun way to save your coins!

title: Nice Picture
text: I ordered this puzzle because it was a familiar brand. The pieces seem well cut out so far. There were a couple that were partially connected, but that wasn't problematic. There has been a lot of puzzle dust which doesn't really harm anything. I would have liked it to come with a poster to use as a reference. It makes it easier to hold one instead of the entire box lid. The picture is nice and vibrant.

title: Fun Mouse Ears
text: These are fun mouse ears. Overall the quality is pretty good. The band is fairly comfortable and fits both adult and children's heads. The ears are stuffed or padded which is better than a lot of the other ears available. These ears flop a little instead of staying upright which is the only negative thing about it. They don't continuously flop, just slightly during movement.

title: Nice Mouse Ears
text: These are nice mouse ears. According to the tag, it's an official Disney product thru Luv Her. I am not familiar with the Luv Her brand, but I can definitely attest that these ears seem to be official. The noticeable difference is the thickness of the ears. Ears from Disney are thicker/fatter than the cheaper ones. These ears fit me fine. There's no way I could wear them all day, but that's how I am with all headbands. I can't seem to wear them for more than an hour or so at a time before developing a headache. The quality is nice and they look cute, too!

title: Very Good Quality
text: When I was younger, I loved playing Memory! I am happy to have one that's more adult friendly than the one I had many years ago. The cards are sturdy. The images are beautiful. Memory is one of those games you can easily play by yourself or with others. I didn't even mention that it's a good brain exercise, too!

title: Funny!
text: My 24 year old son plays in a couple of different DND groups. He can't wait to take this to his next one. When I first showed this to him, it made him laugh out loud! He completely understood it while I really wasn't sure what it was for. He said his friends will think it's very funny, too. It's sturdy and feels durable. This would make a great gift or stocking stuffer!

title: A Beautiful Plush Animal
text: This is a beautiful plush animal. It's a good representation of what a wolf looks like. Pair this with a box about wolves and you have a great gift! It's an excellent quality!

title: Fun Addition to the Lego Succulents Set
text: This light kit is a fun addition to the Lego Succulents Set. It was a slight pain putting it on the completed Lego set. It wasn't that it was difficult, it was more that it was tricky to work in the small areas. The finished lights really make it stand out! I wish there was a better way to conceal the wires and parts.

title: Very Good Quality
text: My 24 year old son is a fan of League of Legends. I wasn't really sure what this was other than some kind of League of Legends collectible. The quality is much nicer than I anticipated. My son was very pleased with it. He has placed them on a shelf near his computer. This would make a great gift for any League of Legends fan!

title: Great Puzzle!
text: I am a fan of Springbok's puzzles. One thing that stands out in that the pieces are a little larger than most other puzzles. I find that to be a plus. When I'm finished, I take my puzzles to the nursing home where my father lives. There are a group of women there known as the "puzzle ladies".  They're in the 80's and enjoy puzzles, but they have difficulties with small pieces. This one is perfect for them. The image is fun and is getting me in the holiday spirit. The pieces seem to be well cut and there hasn't been much if any puzzle dust.

title: Does What it Says
text: I was recently on a road trip with my sister and her kids. I got this to entertain my 9 year old niece. Her older siblings have their type of smart watch, so I thought that this would be good for her. As far as looks go, it looks like other smart watches. My niece enjoyed taking pictures and videos on it. She spent some time playing some of the games. It did entertain her on the trip. However, I really don't think it will be something that will engage her regularly. I think she had fun with it because it was new.

title: Love This!
text: I love this puzzle advent calendar. I was a little skeptical at first, but upon seeing it in person and opening it up, I am a fan! The calendar has 24 little boxes. Each box contains puzzle pieces for a section of the whole puzzle. I opened box 1. I wasn't sure if the pieces were random or if they were continuous. The pieces were for a corner of the puzzle. If the pieces weren't for an entire section, I worried that it would be impossible to put together by only working on a few pieces each day. I've included a picture of what I was able to do after the first box. It comes with a huge poster so you can refer to it while working on it, but I didn't have to use it very much. Since there were only a few pieces to work with, it wasn't overwhelming or too difficult. I only did the 1st box. I am saving the rest of it so I can do this in December. The pieces are a little small, but they are a good quality. I didn't have any puzzle dust. There were no peeling pieces. I am excited to do the rest of this closer to the holidays!

title: So Many Options!
text: This baby gym by V-Tech has so many options for how to use it. It's colorful and very appealing. It has plenty to keep baby busy! There are plenty of colors, textures, sounds, and patterns to stimulate young minds. Batteries are included, but it is recommended that you replace them with fresh batteries.

title: Cute Collectible!
text: These Ted Lasso character Little People figures are a cute collectible. Some of the likenesses are better than others. I think Coach Beard, Ted, & Roy look closest to the original characters.

title: Wow!
text: I ordered this Lego train set, not sure who would want to build it. I have 2 kids in their early 20's - one in college, the other one who just started his first full time job. Then there's my husband and me, both in our mid 50's. It sat around for over a week without being touched. Then one Saturday night, my husband asked me if I would like to build it with him. I've never been much of a Lego builder. Both kids were and my husband was when he was a kid. I think my brother used to have some and I would build houses with them. Well, it took 2 nights to complete it, but we successfully built this train set. Wow! This is quite the Lego set! The instructions were easy to follow, as we expected with Lego. There were some extra pieces if needed. The train power source required a total of 10 AAA batteries.  My husband, who is a tech guy and loves all things nerdy/geeky really enjoyed playing with this train. It works really well. You can control and adjust the speed. We did learn that if you go at maximum speed, it jumps the track.  There are working headlights. It's really a cool set! We had a lot of fun with it. We're still having fun with it because it's still set up on the table.

title: Puzzle Mat
text: My daughter loves puzzles. However, she lives in a small place and doesn't have a space large enough to work on them. Her coffee table width is about 2 inches too small to complete average sized puzzles. This mat can easily be placed on her coffee table and provide her with a good work space. If she can't work on her puzzle for a few days, she can fold this up without losing her progress. The surface is soft and while it keeps pieces from moving around too much, it also doesn't allow you to move sections around easily. This is working very well for her. She's happy to be able to puzzle again!

title: As Described
text: My 24 year old son still collects Pokemon cards. He says that these are genuine Pokemon cards and that they are as described. He claimed the Ultra Rare card for himself and plans to give the rest to his younger cousins.

title: Great Size of Pieces
text: I love puzzles. This is something new for me that came out of the pandemic. This brand is one that I was familiar with. I really like the size of the pieces. They're not too small and they have a decent thickness to them. Plus there was minimal puzzle dust. I like the overall image, but I do want to note that there was no poster of the image included. That really makes it easier for me with my 50-year-old eyes. Plus if someone's helping me, one of us can use the poster and the other can use the box. Overall, it's a good puzzle.

title: Good Value
text: My 24 year old son still collects Pokemon cards. I showed him this set and let him look through the cards. He agreed that they were authentic Pokemon cards. He also felt that the description was accurate and that this was a good value for what you get. This would be good for someone who is starting their Pokemon collection.

title: Fun!
text: My daughter and her friends love the Hunt a Killer games. They were very excited to try this new one involving a jigsaw puzzle. The clues are realistic looking like they are in the other Hunt a Killer sets. The addition of the puzzle is new. The puzzle is a 1000 piece puzzle, so that took my daughter and her friends more than one evening to complete. They were a little concerned about the puzzle since you don't get a picture of the puzzle image, but it wasn't too difficult to do. It's a one time play game, but she always passes her games on to others to play. Overall, my daughter says this is a fun game, but for times sake, the traditional games work better for her over the ones with puzzles.

title: Cute Snake Pool Float
text: This is a cute snake pool float. We like it because it's different and not the typical float. It seems to be sturdy. I expect it to at least last through the pool season.

title: Excellent Kit!
text: I have been enjoying rock painting for the last few months. It's an activity that brings me joy. This is an excellent kit for those who are new to it or more experienced like me. The rocks in the kit are a great size for painting. The guide book not only gives lots of great ideas, but has step by step photo directions so you can easily replicate their designs and ideas. I really like using the transfer stickers. It gives a good outline that you can fill in with the paint. The googly eyes add some dimension, but I personally don't really care for the look. I happily recommend this kit!

title: Pool Fun!
text: I've been house sitting for my sister this past week. They have a nice in-ground pool which I used a lot during this hot week. This pool float is durable and held up to a week of heavy use. It's very cute - I like the floral design. The cupholder is small and only holds a regular water bottle or beverage can.

title: Great Doll!
text: My daughter loved American Girl dolls when she was younger. It has been a while since I had seen any of the newer dolls. I was unfamiliar with the Truly Me series. I think it's great that American Girl has these contemporary dolls that have changed with the times. This doll is well made. I love her blue hair! And the hair isn't just one color, it's got some streaks which make it look realistic. She comes with a book about Friends which is geared toward 3rd and 4th graders. She is a great addition to the American Girl family!

title: Thomas the Tank Engine
text: Great Thomas starter kit! This train set is perfect for someone just starting his or her Thomas the Tank Engine collection! It comes with a small amount of train tracks, a small building, one train car and of course, Thomas! It's sturdy and will last for years! This would make a great gift!

title: Fun Little Game
text: This is a fun little game. It's perfect for the cat lady in your life! The pieces are wooden and durable. The object of the game is to stack all of the cats onto the lady. I haven't been able to do it yet, but I have had fun trying!

title: As Described
text: This set of Pokemon cards is as described. I gave this to my 24 year old son who is still a big Pokemon fan. He said the description was accurate as far as the rare and foil cards. He actually found a couple that he felt was worth keeping. The rest he will share with his younger cousins who are ages 8-13. They will be thrilled!  He says this set is good for beginners.

title: Great Stickers!
text: These are great stickers! The quality is good. There were no inappropriate or offensive stickers in this pack.

title: Fun Assortment
text: My 24 year old son has been collecting Pokemon cards for years. This set of 20 "rare" cards, according to him, may technically be better than average cards, but they're fairly common. Out of the 20, he kept 2 for himself. The rest he will divide between his younger cousins. If you're new to collecting, these will probably be pretty good.

title: Good for Beginners
text: This set of Pokemon cards is good for beginners. You get a lot of cards for the price. The cards are from smaller packages and I'm assuming that they have been picked over before repackaging them. This set does include 10 hologram cards. For the most part the cards were pretty basic, but if you're just starting out as a collector, it's a good way to grow your collection.

title: Great Puzzle Set
text: The mother of my close friend has dementia. I go and hang out with her mother on occasion to give my friend a break. I recently took this puzzle set with me on a recent visit. The quality of the puzzle is really good. The pieces are sturdy. I think they are made from plastic foam board or something similar. They are also large sized and easy to grasp. The set includes some questions to ask while working on the puzzle. I found that some of the questions were a little too elementary, but most of them were fine. There was also a little paperback book with large colored bird pictures. My friend's mother enjoyed looking through the pictures. According to my friend, her mother had never been much of a puzzle person. She found this 24 piece puzzle to be difficult. I am wondering if a regular puzzler with dementia would have more success.  I don't fault the puzzle for her difficulties.

title: Fun Puzzle!
text: Being a beer lover, I thought this would be a fun puzzle to complete. I was right! I liked the subject matter and the illustration. The pieces were cut well. I didn't come across any peeling pieces. It does come with a poster for your reference which I appreciate. There wasn't much if any puzzle dust. I found that the tube container was a little difficult when it came to putting the pieces back into it when I was finished. This would make a great give for beer lovers!

title: Fun!
text: I ordered this remote control car for my 55 year old husband. He had one about 20 years ago when our kids were little and he loved playing with it out on the cul-de-sac. This one looks awesome. It's very contemporary looking. It goes pretty fast. The remote control is different from the old one that he had. He has found it to be okay, but it's a little more challenging to make turns than the older style one. It could just be a matter of needing more practice. It is a good quality and not just a child's toy.

title: Fun Craft Kit
text: I have been seeing Diamond Art Painting everywhere, but I have been hesitant to try it myself. I thought it would be difficult. I ordered this to give it a try before attempting a larger and more detailed set. I was a little confused at first, but I watched a good Youtube video that helped me a lot. I definitely think I can handle the larger ones. This is a fun craft kit and a good introduction to the world of diamond art painting.

title: Nice Size for Adults
text: This is a large pool float. It's a nice size for adults. The float is a mix of inflatable parts and mesh so you don't have to inflate the entire thing. The head rest/back rest is a little on the low side. It's designed more for fully reclining rather than sitting. There's a cup holder. Overall, it's a good addition for the pool!

title: Fun!
text: I help out a teacher friend of mine by watching her autistic son on the teacher work days when the teachers work but the students stay home. He's 19 and I have been watching him for years. I have spent many times watching Ice Age with him over the years. I ordered this to keep at my house for the times he comes over. I am excited for him to see it when he comes over next. Batteries are included! The acorn is magnetic. Scrat makes some noises and shakes. What's not to love!

title: Waiting for the Pool to Open!
text: This pool lounger is amazing! I can't wait for the pool to open. When I say "open", I mean warm up enough that I can get in the pool. I suppose this would be okay since it keeps you out of the water! It's easy to inflate and deflate, as far as pool inflatables go. I love the recline/lounge position. It's very comfortable.

title: Great Set!
text: This is a great set of Star Wars figures! They are from a variety of Star Wars movies & TV shows.  The figures are individually wrapped in tissue paper. Any accessories are loose in that wrapping. As I was opening them, some of the weapons would fall out and nearly got lost in the sofa cushions. I should have opened it at the table instead. In my family, I have a lot less Star Wars knowledge than my husband and son. Since the weapons were loose, I wasn't sure which ones went to which figures. It would have been nice if there had been a sheet with the figures and their accessories to go with this. Or if they had been printed on the box. The product description shows them all, but it would be helpful to have them all together.

title: Fun Travel Game
text: This is a fun travel game. It doesn't take up much space so he's easy to fit in a bag and take along with you. The game is easy to play once you've got a good understanding of the rules. It took us at least a round or two before we all finally got the hang of it. It works for 2 to 6 players. Overall, it's a fun game.

title: Educational
text: This is a cute and educational plush frog. My daughter is studying wildlife biology at college. I thought she might get a kick out of this new plush toy. And I was right, she loves it. The frog has a buttoned panel across his belly. When you unbutton it, you can see his internal organs. Each organ is attached with ribbon. The ribbon is labeled with the organ name. The organs open up and have some simple illustrations. It's mainly just line drawings. There are little fly drawings on the inside of the stomach. There are also fatty pieces which according to my daughter who recently dissected a frog, these look very accurate. Overall I think this is a great educational toy. It comes with a pamphlet of suggested activities.

title: Fun!
text: My daughter loves this type of "murder mystery" activity. It's an updated version of the classic "whodunnit". There are no scripts like the old style murder mystery. You're basically given a file of evidence to go through. The material is decent and most of the pieces look authentic which makes it more fun. You can't really do it more than once, but you could easily pass it along to a friend when you're finished. This can be done by yourself or with a few friends/family members.

title: Fun!
text: This is a fun Hot Wheels track set. The directions are clear and set up was straight forward. The recommended age seems correct. Younger players will probably need help putting it together. It would be fun for a parent/child to do together. One car is provided which is always nice but I'm sure the target audience already has a lot of cars!

title: Beautiful Pictures
text: I was drawn to this deck of cards because of the beautiful pictures. I was disappointed to find that the pictures are only on the face cards and the numbered cards are plain. The quality of the cards is decent. They're comparable to other basic cards. My daughter likes the set.

title: Fun
text: This is a fun track set for Hot Wheels. The recommended age of five and up is reasonable. Assembly required a little bit of grown up assistance. It does take a little effort to launch vehicles but it is fun to watch and play.

title: Soft Plushy
text: This kitty plush is very soft. It seems to be made well with no loose strings. The picture with the product description makes it look much larger than it is in person. The one I got is smaller than a soccer ball or close to it in size. At the price listed I could buy a larger name brand plushie.

title: Different
text: These stuffed animals are different and unique. They each have 2 sides/faces. It's easy to switch back and forth. They arrive compressed, but do expand rather quickly. They're smallish. They feel soft, but aren't super fluffy like the Squishmallows. The kids seem to like them.

title: Well......
text: I ordered this for my 24 year old son. I'm not sure if he or my husband was more excited. Because it's so big, it comes in parts and has to be assembled. That makes it less durable than one that was all one unit. It's definitely a unique shape. My son is into cosplay and thinks it will make a great base for a prop. He says he will probably add some additional supports to the barrel so it will be a little sturdier. The scope doesn't work well at all. My son has several Nerf guns. Most of them of just okay, but usable scopes. This one is less than okay and not usable. There's nowhere to store the darts. It's not super accurate, but it does work alright. The fire rate is very slow. So overall, it's okay. It's definitely a new and different shape. My son is actually really excited about working on this. If you're wanting this to battle with others, you should keep looking. If you're more of a collector, then you might enjoy this.

title: A Sweet Teddy Bear
text: This is a sweet Teddy Bear. He's soft and cuddly. His features are secure and well done. He will make someone very happy.

title: Really Soft!
text: This plush fox is really soft. It's also very cute. It's also very small. I didn't read the size in the description, so that's on me. There's only one picture of the item, so maybe an additional picture that shows a representation of its size would be helpful. Overall, it's very nicely made.

title: Cute Gnomes!
text: I like decorating for the different holidays. These gnomes are a great size for my tiered tray. They are well made with nice details. They are weighted on the bottom so they won't tip over too easily. I am very happy with them.

title: Nice Kit
text: I have been fascinated with these mini house kits. I have a few so far.This one is a nice kit. It comes with glue and tweezers in addition to all of the other supplies. The directions are clear enough. I've started working on this one. It does require me to use a special magnifying lamp because everything is so small and my near vision is horrible. So far, I am very pleased with how it's going.

title: Huggable!
text: This stuffed dino arrived compressed. Once it was opened, it didn't take too long for it to expand into its normal size. It's a soft and huggable stuffed animal. It's a decent quality. It did take almost exactly 2 months to arrive which I didn't know until after I ordered it. It did arrive a couple of days before estimated.

title: Educational
text: My 23 year old son collects rocks, minerals and crystals. I thought this would be a fun addition to his collection. It is nice seeing real samples of rocks and minerals displayed and labeled. It's an educational reference item for collectors. It is pretty small. The whole thing is smaller than an 8x10 picture. My son didn't have any difficulties reading the labels, but my eyes found it problematic. This would be great for a classroom.

title: Great Stickers
text: My daughter is in college studying wildlife biology. She loves nature and the outdoors. She was very happy to get these stickers. I would say that 95% of them are nature and outdoors related. There were a couple of odd ones such as a Disney's Haunted Mansion sticker and an ET one. We love Disney and the Haunted Mansion and ET is a fine, nostalgic movie. They just felt a little out of place. There may have been one or two more that we felt were in the wrong mix, too, but the majority of them are outdoors/nature themed. The sticker quality is good and comparable to other sticker sets. They seem to be printed pretty well.

title: Good Collectible
text: This League of Legends figurine is a good collectible. It looks a lot like the character. It's a nice quality. It stands up well. My son is a League of Legends fan and he is pleased with his new character.

title: Nice Set of Reference Cards for D&D
text: This is a nice set of reference cards dor D&D. My 23 year old son is the D&D player in our family, though many years ago, my husband was one. My son likes them and finds them helpful during game play. I would have to agree with the other reviewer about the small print, but my son is young and doesn't seem to mind. Illustrations are good.

title: Realistic Movements
text: I ordered this after seeing a video of a cat playing with a similar snake toy. My cats were entertained, but not enough to get up and attack it. The snake makes realistic movements which are fun to watch. There is a USB cable so you can charge it. It seems to get stuck easily. It also doesn't sense drop offs. Other than that, it's amusing.

title: Large Size
text: I've seen these bubble pop things all over the place, but I have never tried one before. I thought it might be a fun stocking stuffer for my kids. They are pretty large - at least larger than I expected. I was playing with one myself. I didn't find it as satisfying as I thought I would.  Several of the bubbles came undone or unpopped and I had to go back and repop them. They seem fine. The shapes were fun. Will have to wait and see if the kids (both in college) like them.

title: Wonderful Barbie Doll
text: I love that there have been some great black Barbie dolls lately. This is my second Brooklyn doll and she's awesome! I especially like that it's not just a black version of Barbie. Brooklyn's hair is braided and she has edging near her forehead. With details like that, she stands out from the traditional Barbie. She comes with lots of camping/hiking accessories and a puppy! She will bring happiness to a young girl!

title: Brings Back Memories!
text: This game sure brings back memories. I love that the game has the original box design! The game play is just like I remembered. I let my nieces and nephew play with it and they really enjoyed it. It does help with deduction and reasoning skills.

title: Fun Advent Calendar
text: I was a little surprised with some of the negative reviews. If you don't regularly buy rocks and minerals, I can see that you might be disappointed, but my 23 year old son buys and collects them and they are often very small pieces. If you want larger ones, it's going to cost a pretty penny! Now, until I opened it, I was a little worried. There was a lot of noise when I shook it. I was afraid everything would be broken and crumbly or that items had gotten mixed up inside.  I was very pleasantly surprised. Everything was in tact and looked great. I got this calendar for my son that I mentioned above. I always get my kids a fun advent countdown calender. I was able to open it from the top and slide the tray out without damaging the perforated doors/windows (or whatever you call the openings). The tray was divided and everything was in its place and looked great. I do not know a lot about rocks and minerals, but from my novice point of view, they are nice. Some are raw, others are polished. There are fossils in addition to the rocks and minerals. The first thing you open is a little magnifying glass and cloth. My son uses a jewelry loupe to examine his collection, but for a new collector, I'm sure what is provided will be useful. The quality of the items seems to be good and comparable to some of the ones that I have purchased for my son in the past.  In order to get the large, cool ones, you have to spend a lot of money! This is actually impressive to receive such a variety of items at this cost. I think my son will have fun opening it.

title: Soft!
text: This plush octopus is unique and interesting. I haven't seen many plush octopuses during my life. This one is cute and soft. He arrived compressed and squished, but once the package was opened, he filled out. There is a small loop/string on the top of his head. I am guessing that is so you can hang him up.

title: Soft Kitty!
text: This is definitely what I would call a gimmicky toy, but in all fairness, it's a sweet toy. The plush kitty is very soft. The details are embroidered which is always good for younger children. Batteries are required (not included). There's an instruction booklet which tells you how to change the colors and other features. I haven't seen this on TV - I must not be watching the right shows!

title: Plush Sloth
text: This plush sloth is definitely cute. He's not very fluffy, but he is soft. Quality is better than what you might win at the carnival. Eyes and nose are plastic. They seem to be secure. He's bound to bring a smile to his new owner!

title: Disney Princesses
text: These little Disney Princess dolls are basically Polly Pockets. They will provide lots of fun for your little princess and some grief to Mom & Dad! I say that with humor (and a little bit of seriousness) because my 20 year old daughter went through the Polly Pocket phase and the small pieces often got lost. And then found years later! There are 12 different Disney Princesses and they all come with 2 outfits. The dolls are wearing one outfit and then there's a separate outfit for the Royal Ball. The dolls are all individually wrapped in tissue paper, as are the spare outfits. I've included a picture. Also, the box is pretty boring and doesn't have any full color photos of what you're getting. So if you're not familiar with this toy set, then you won't know what you have until they're all opened. That could be fun or it could be annoying. Since they're all individually wrapped, it would be great to use for homemade Advent calendars or or party favors.

title: Very Soft
text: This guy arrived in a semi-compressed bag. I think the bag may have leaked air because it wasn't fully compressed like some. So when I opened the bag, he remained flat. All it took was some squeezing and fluffing and he quickly filled out. I would say he is pretty similar to the popular Squishmallows. He's very soft and squeezable. As a pillow, he's a good size. My 20 year old daughter has several Squishmallows and often uses them as a pillow. He seems to be made well as far as I can tell.

title: Panda Plush
text: This plush panda toy is soft. It comes compressed down, but it expands to its regular size in a relatively short amount of time. It's very huggable. It has no strong chemical odor.

title: Comes with 3 Mini Figs
text: This Lego set is not just a building set. It is interactive, too. It has a vehicle that shoots things. The instructions are easy to follow and understand. It comes with 3 mini figs which is nice. Lego is usually good about that. I've gotten other brand play sets that come with just one figure and that makes for less enjoyable playtime. This Lego set is a tie-in to the Monkie Kid show but it is still fun for those who aren't familiar with it.

title: Beautiful Doll
text: This Wellie Wisher Kendall doll is beautiful. The Wellie Wisher dolls are smaller than the original American Girl dolls and geared toward a slightly younger audience. Though a separate product line, they do share some of the American Girl traits. For example, the painted teeth look very similar. This doll is a excellent quality and is what I would expect from the American Girl brand. She would make a wonderful gift!

title: Smaller Than American Girl Dolls
text: The Wellie Wisher dolls are related to the American Girl Dolls. They're smaller than the AG Dolls and geared toward a younger audience. The dolls have the same quality that the larger AG dolls have. The doll doesn't come with much more than just her outfit. She is sturdy as far as dolls go. Supposedly there are books based on these new dolls, too.

title: Large Playset
text: This Spidey playset is pretty big. It was larger than I expected. It was easy to put together. Only 1 figure & vehicle is included, so if you really want to play out the cartoon, you need to buy more. It comes installed with batteries, which is nice. The volume on the toy is loud and I don't see any way to control it. It's a sturdy playset. The recommended age seems appropriate.

title: Fun Lego Set
text: This is a fun Lego set! The jet looks really cool when it's assembled. Lego is pretty good about clear instructions to follow. This was no exception. The recommended age is appropriate, though a slightly younger builder might do fine with a little guidance. There are 4 mini-figs included. I think this would be fun for Lego fans, regardless of the Monkie Kid tie-in.

title: Absolutely Adorable!
text: I ordered this for my daughter. It is absolutely adorable! It's made well, too. It comes with a little adhesive sticker to attach to the dashboard. There are also felt discs that you can add Essential Oils or perfume to so it works as an air freshener. My daughter is very excited to have this in her car!

title: Cute Doll
text: I was unfamiliar with the Wellie Wisher dolls by American Girl until recently when I saw them at Costco. I came home and looked them up online. These dolls are about 4 inches shorter than the traditional American Girl dolls. The target audience is a little younger than the AG audience. I think it's a nice transition between baby dolls and the American Girl doll line. Evidently there are books that go along with the Wellie Wisher dolls, but it's not included. Here you basically get the doll and her outfit which includes the Wellie boots, hence the name of the collection. Ashlyn looks like she could be Hispanic or Latin American. Regardless, I am pleased to see some diversity in the collection. She's really cute and seems to be well made. This model is a newer one. It looks like the original Wellie Wisher dolls had issues with their legs coming off. I really hope that they fixed that issue with this new release.

title: Fun Skate Park!
